description: After a Collect pay is settled (status paid or trial), use this tool with the publicId from pay_offering. It branches by offering type: research/asset returns the file; MCP lists seller tools (omit toolName) or runs one (pass toolName + toolArguments); API proxies method+path(+body) through Vybe. Prefer this over inventing HTTP calls or scraping marketplace HTML. Related: pay_offering, list_recent_pays, fetch_paid_content.

inputSchema.description: publicId is required. For MCP, omit toolName to list tools, then pass toolName to run one. For API, pass method and path.

body.description: API only: JSON body for POST/PUT/PATCH.

method.description: API only: HTTP method, e.g. GET or POST. Defaults to GET.

path.description: API only: path under the offering invoke base, e.g. /v1/scan.

publicId.description: Vybe payment request id from pay_offering or list_recent_pays.

toolArguments.description: MCP only: JSON arguments for tools/call.

toolName.description: MCP only: seller tool name from the prior tools/list response.

inputSchema.title: UsePaidOfferingInput

name: use_paid_offering

outputSchema.description: Unlocked content, MCP tool list/result, or API response.
outputSchema.title: UsePaidOfferingResult

title: Use paid Collect offering
